verdict.rationale: Stripe documents virtual cards scoped to a single task or session that are automatically invalidated after use, which covers the single-use part. Spending controls can restrict by merchant ID and cap spend per authorization, and the synchronous real-time authorization webhook lets a developer approve or decline each charge, so exact-amount and single-merchant rules can be enforced in code. Missing for 10: a native exact-amount or merchant-lock card parameter (it needs a custom webhook or a per-authorization cap), explicit merchant allow-listing (the docs describe blocking), and independent or hands-on corroboration of single-use invalidation.
